rules:
AUTHORITATIVE CURRENT PROGRAM: Europe/Athens daily 11:00 one six-sign zodiac carousel alternating Group A/B by date; 15:00 one coherent five-card love/soul story; 17:00 one new fact-checked strange real phenomenon video; 23:00 one different international/foreign legend video. Greek myths remain postponed. No 08:00/12-sign schedule, no fillers, no dog/barista/terrier, no avatars, no Flying Dutchman.
QA/AUDIO: 11:00 and 15:00 use music and no narration. TikTok native photo carousel requires JPEG/WebP and autoAddMusic=true. Facebook/Instagram use complete native carousel where supported; lack of native music support there does not block. YouTube uses the complete slideshow. 17:00 and 23:00 are 9:16 narrated Greek videos with burned-in synchronized subtitles, no background music, no avatar/presenter, TikTok auto-music false/omitted. While Azure Speech F0/Nestoras is active, each new feature video must be >=90s, preferably 95-115s and <=120s, with no filler, no dead-air gap >1.2s, natural sentence pauses usually <=0.8s, and trailing silence <=0.5s.
STABILITY: once a verified future record is active draft=false/autoPublish=true, do not roll it back merely because the slot is future or stale local metadata exists. Deactivate only on concrete live media/provider/duplicate/forbidden-content evidence or later user stop/change.
SAFETY: one logical post per date+category+platform, max five hashtags, fresh live read before write, preserve published successes, reconcile unknown writes, never backdate/catch up automatically, never blind-retry provider/account-limit failures, no purchases/topups/upgrades/paid safety tests.
